reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the rendered redline is byte-identical to the original paragraphs with no comment, which is exactly what a compliant finding should look like.

The rule's preferred position is 'No non-solicit on Customer'; the rationale documents targeted searches ('solicit', 'hire', 'induce', 'employ or engage') plus a read of the General Provisions and covenant articles with no non-solicit, no-hire or inducement covenant found, so absence maps to the preferred position rather than a 'missing' finding.
The cited entire-agreement clause (15.9) is apt supporting evidence that no superseded instrument imposes a non-solicit on Customer.

The failed deterministic checks (duration number not found, no general-solicitation carve-out) are expected artifacts of there being no non-solicit clause to measure and do not undercut the compliance conclusion.
No actionable proposal is required because compliant findings are retained as internal evidence, not raised as negotiation issues.
